summary.en: Accio (Alibaba Accio Work, China) on magpie without the Accio desktop app: sign in on the web page (PKCE + loopback callback), then serve the account's live model catalog with credit multipliers, tool calls, reasoning split out, token refresh, a quota card, and an optional local OpenAI-compatible reverse proxy.
summary.zh: 不需要 Accio 桌面客户端：在网页登录（PKCE + 本机回环回调）后，把阿里 Accio Work（中国版）的模型接进 magpie —— 实时目录带积分倍率、工具调用、思维链分离、自动续期、额度卡片，并可选在本机开一个 OpenAI 兼容反代端口。
